title: Agent-eval export manifest (schemaVersion 1)
description: One manifest per exported run (RAI-040). The manifest pins identity, lineage, coverage and section-integrity digests for the run directory; it never carries verdicts, usage numbers or tool arguments itself. Honesty rules pinned here: finishedAtMs is null whenever the run has no terminal evidence (and runStatus is then 'partial'); unknown usage prices are reported through coverage.usage.unknownPrice, never as zeros; reconciliation.jsonl is deliberately NOT pinned in integrity because it is append-only and self-chained (see reconciliation.jsonl.schema.json). lineage.rootId must equal runId; verifier coverage must satisfy pending = expected - produced and absent = episodes - expected; these cross-field laws are enforced by the validating codecs and lineage reconstruction in modules/eval-export (a plain JSON Schema validator cannot express the arithmetic).

finishedAtMs.description: Null while the run has no terminal evidence; never invented. A non-null finish forces runStatus=complete only if every episode completed.

rootId.description: Equals runId: one export is one lineage root.

parentJobId.description: Null for the single root job; otherwise the parent job must appear EARLIER in this array (parents before children, reconstructible in one pass).

produced.description: Episodes with an ACTUAL verifier verdict in verdicts.jsonl.

pending.description: Declared verifiers that produced nothing: expected - produced. A pending episode has NO verdict; it is never fabricated.

absent.description: Episodes that declared no verifier: episodes - expected.

withObserved.description: Calls whose usage.observedMicroUsd is a number.

unknownPrice.description: Calls whose usage is honestly unknown (unknown=true). Unknown prices stay null in calls.jsonl; they are never zeros and never fabricated.

sha256.description: Lowercase 64-hex sha256 over UTF-8 bytes (JDK java.security.MessageDigest convention used across the repository).
